J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.

RiXu4xOZd-oJDJDyMjxXkg.en: In Cayo District in western Belize, 4 cases were reported on 15 April; 1 was imported from Guatemala and 3 were locally acquired. This is the first reported locally acquired case in 6 years. Authorities have taken a number of prevention and control measures.
